text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- According to unnofficial sources, six out of 28 Liberal Party parliamentarians are to defect to the ruling Social Democratic Alliance (SDAM). The Liberal Party leadership has denied the claims.

- The Retirement Fund of Macedonia has proposed changes in the system of payments. The lowest pension rate was to fall 10 percent. The highest pensions to be pegged at 65 percent of the average national income (around 300 Deutsche Marks per month).

- The Skopje local council to be convened on December 19th. The assembly has 25 members: SDAM - 8, opposition Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organisation - 6, Democratic Party - 3, Liberal Party - 3. The remaining seats distributed among minor parties.

- Talks between the Macedonian and North Greece chambers of commerce have taken place. The president of the Macedonian chamber Dusan Petreski said trade in the first 10 months of 1996 was worth $112.8 million, and could increase to $300 million next year.
